summary.text: Phil Mallow is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 75, where he has served since 2020, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He worked as a manager with United Parcel Service and lives in Fairmont.

paragraphs.text: Phil Mallow was born in Cumberland, Maryland, and lives in Fairmont, West Virginia.
He earned a degree in quality control technology from Allegany College of Maryland in 1977.
His career experience includes working as a manager with United Parcel Service.
Mallow has served in the House of Delegates since 2020 and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
